propositions: Empty file_impact value conflates author omission with explicit no-file-impact declaration; a third tri-state value is needed to distinguish undeclared from none
FILE_IMPACT event payload and reducer state must support file_impact_scope (undeclared/paths/none) and no_file_impact_reason to replace empty file_impact overloading
set-file-impact CLI command must move to variadic _ARGV_REGISTRY and parse both legacy JSON-array form and new --none form with mandatory reason text of at least 10 non-whitespace characters
get_file_impact_scope library function and declare_no_file_impact MCP tool must read and write the tri-state consistently with reducer state and validate reason length
Reducer derivation rule must enforce mutual exclusivity: non-empty file_impact → paths; empty file_impact + payload scope none → none; otherwise → undeclared
All state transitions (undeclared↔paths, paths↔none, undeclared↔none) must preserve last-writer-wins replacement in process_file_impact
